prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating floor bitmap for a top-down 16-pixel-grid tactical RPG, interior old library. Generate a single edge-to-edge square texture ONLY: warm desaturated medium-brown interior parquet floor made of short narrow wooden blocks in a restrained herringbone arrangement. Clearly fitted indoor carpentry, NOT ship-deck planks, NOT rough outdoor boards: no nails, no ropes, no gaps, no dirt, no green moss, no objects. The artwork should look like a polished classic tactical RPG pixel-art texture drawn at exactly 64 by 64 logical pixels and enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels, all hard-edged pixels, no blur and no photographic grain. Muted grey-brown / soft walnut palette; low local contrast so units and furniture stay readable, subtle fine wood grain, dry matte worn surface, even overhead light, no directional shadows. Tile seamlessly on all four edges with consistent herringbone rhythm. No border, no vignette, no text, no frame, no drop shadow, no perspective or isometric view. Fill the entire square with floor texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one seamless repeating interior stone-floor bitmap for a top-down 16-pixel-grid tactical RPG old archive hall. Generate an edge-to-edge square floor texture ONLY. Dry honed warm-grey limestone slabs, modest rectangular 2:1 slabs laid in tidy staggered courses, thin narrow mortar seams, subtly worn smooth surfaces, slight warm taupe variations. It must read as maintained INDOOR STONE FLOOR, distinct from rough exterior cobblestones and dirt roads, and distinct from polished white ceremonial marble: no marble veins, no sheen, no gold, no mosaic, no outdoor debris, no moss, no cracks, no stones sticking up. Classic hand-authored tactical RPG pixel-art, looks drawn at exactly 64x64 logical pixels and enlarged nearest-neighbor, crisp pixel edges, restrained low contrast, even diffuse indoor light. Fill the square evenly, seamless matching four edges, no directional shadows, no border, no frame, no text, no furniture, no perspective or isometric angle.
